## Problem 1 - OOP Programming

```{r}
library(methods)
```

```{r}
#' S4 Class Representing a Wald Confidence Interval
#'
#' @slot lb Numeric scalar lower bound.
#' @slot ub Numeric scalar upper bound.
#' @slot mean Numeric scalar point estimate (center).
#' @slot sterr Numeric scalar standard error.
#' @slot level Numeric scalar confidence level in (0, 1).
setClass(
  "waldCI",
  slots = c(
    lb = "numeric",
    ub = "numeric",
    mean = "numeric",
    sterr = "numeric",
    level = "numeric"
  )
)
```

A constructor, which takes in a confidence level (0,1) and either a mean and standard error, or a lower and upper bound. This should be a custom constructor, not new() or waldCI().

```{r}
.waldCIBounds <- function (level, mean, sterr) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level) / 2)
  lb <- mean - z * sterr
  ub <- mean + z * sterr
  list(lb = lb, ub = ub)
}

.waldCIMeanSterr <- function (level, lb, ub) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level) / 2)
  mean <- (lb + ub) / 2
  sterr <- (ub - lb) / (2 * z)
  list(mean = mean, sterr = sterr)
}

#' Constructor for `waldCI`
#'
#' Constructs a `waldCI` object from a confidence level and either
#' (`mean` and `sterr`) or (`lb` and `ub`).
#'
#' @param level Confidence level strictly between 0 and 1
#' @param mean point estimate
#' @param sterr standard error
#' @param lb lower bound
#' @param ub upper bound
#' @return waldCI object.
wald_ci <- function(level, mean = NULL, sterr = NULL, lb = NULL, ub = NULL) {
  if (missing(level) || !is.numeric(level) || length(level) != 1L ||
      is.na(level) || level <= 0 || level >= 1) {
    stop("'level' must be a numeric value in (0, 1).")
  }
  if (is.null(mean) != is.null(sterr)) {
    stop("Provide both 'mean' and 'sterr' or neither.")
  }
  if (is.null(lb) != is.null(ub)) {
    stop("Provide both 'lb' and 'ub' or neither.")
  }
  if (is.null(mean) == is.null(lb)) {
    stop("You must supply either ('mean' and 'sterr') or ('lb' and 'ub'). But not both.")
  }

  if (!is.null(mean)) {
    if (sterr <= 0) {
      stop("'sterr' must be positive.")
    }
    lb_ub <- .waldCIBounds(level, mean, sterr)
    new(
      "waldCI",
      lb = as.numeric(lb_ub$lb),
      ub = as.numeric(lb_ub$ub),
      mean = as.numeric(mean),
      sterr = as.numeric(sterr),
      level = as.numeric(level)
    )
  } else {
    mean_sterr <- .waldCIMeanSterr(level, lb, ub)
    new(
      "waldCI",
      lb = as.numeric(lb),
      ub = as.numeric(ub),
      mean = as.numeric(mean_sterr$mean),
      sterr = as.numeric(mean_sterr$sterr),
      level = as.numeric(level)
    )
  }
}
```

A validator

```{r}
setValidity("waldCI", function(obj) {
  slot_names <- c("lb", "ub", "mean", "sterr", "level")
  for (s in slot_names) {
    val <- slot(obj, s)
    if (!is.numeric(val) || length(val) != 1L || is.na(val) || !is.finite(val)) {
      stop(sprintf("Slot '%s' must be a numeric scalar.", s))
    }
  }
  if (obj@sterr <= 0) {
    stop("'sterr' must be a positive number.")
  }
  if (!(obj@level > 0 && obj@level < 1)) {
    stop("'level' must be strictly between 0 and 1.")
  }
  if (obj@lb >= obj@ub) {
    stop("'lb' must be less than 'ub'.")
  }
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - obj@level) / 2)
  expected_lb <- obj@mean - z * obj@sterr
  expected_ub <- obj@mean + z * obj@sterr
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(c(expected_lb, expected_ub), c(obj@lb, obj@ub)))) {
    return("Slots 'lb', 'ub', 'mean', 'sterr', and 'level' are inconsistent.")
  }
  return(TRUE)
})
```

A `show` method

```{r}
#' Display a `waldCI` object
#'
#' @param object A `waldCI` object.
#' @return Invisibly returns `object`.
setMethod("show", "waldCI", function(object) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "Wald Confidence Interval (%.3f level)\n  [%.4f, %.4f]  (mean = %.4f, SE = %.4f)\n",
    object@level, object@lb, object@ub, object@mean, object@sterr
  ))
  return(invisible(object))
})
```

Accessors: `lb`, `ub`, `mean`, `sterr`, `level`.

```{r}
setGeneric("lb", function(x) standardGeneric("lb"))
#' @title Return the lower bound of `waldCI`
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @return Its lower bound
setMethod("lb", "waldCI", function(x) slot(x, "lb"))

setGeneric("ub", function(x) standardGeneric("ub"))
#' @title Return the upper bound of `waldCI`
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @return Its upper bound
setMethod("ub", "waldCI", function(x) slot(x, "ub"))

setGeneric("mean")
#' @title Return the mean of `waldCI`
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @return Its mean
setMethod("mean", "waldCI", function(x) slot(x, "mean"))

setGeneric("sterr", function(x) standardGeneric("sterr"))
#' @title Return the standard error of `waldCI`
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @return Its standard error
setMethod("sterr", "waldCI", function(x) slot(x, "sterr"))

setGeneric("level", function(x) standardGeneric("level"))
#' @title Return the confidence level of `waldCI`
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @return Its confidence level
setMethod("level", "waldCI", function(x) slot(x, "level"))
```

```{r}
tryCatch({ setGeneric("lb<-") }, error=function(e) { setGeneric("lb<-", function(obj, value) standardGeneric("lb<-")) })
#' @title Set the lower bound of `waldCI`
#' @param obj A `waldCI` object
#' @param value The new lower bound
#' @return The updated object
setMethod("lb<-", "waldCI", function(obj, value) {
  obj@lb <- value
  obj@ub <- obj@mean + (obj@mean - obj@lb)
  mean_sterr <- .waldCIMeanSterr(obj@level, obj@lb, obj@ub)
  obj@sterr <- mean_sterr$sterr
  validObject(obj)
  return(obj)
})

tryCatch({ setGeneric("ub<-") }, error=function(e) { setGeneric("ub<-", function(obj, value) standardGeneric("ub<-")) })
#' @title Set the upper bound of `waldCI`
#' @param obj A `waldCI` object
#' @param value The new upper bound
#' @return The updated object
setMethod("ub<-", "waldCI", function(obj, value) {
  obj@ub <- value
  obj@lb <- obj@mean - (obj@ub - obj@mean)
  mean_sterr <- .waldCIMeanSterr(obj@level, obj@lb, obj@ub)
  obj@sterr <- mean_sterr$sterr
  validObject(obj)
  return(obj)
})

tryCatch({ setGeneric("mean<-") }, error=function(e) { setGeneric("mean<-", function(obj, value) standardGeneric("mean<-")) })
#' @title Set the mean of `waldCI`
#' @param obj A `waldCI` object
#' @param value The new mean
#' @return The updated object
setMethod("mean<-", "waldCI", function(obj, value) {
  obj@mean <- value
  lb_ub <- .waldCIBounds(obj@level, obj@mean, obj@sterr)
  obj@lb <- lb_ub$lb
  obj@ub <- lb_ub$ub
  validObject(obj)
  return(obj)
})

tryCatch({ setGeneric("sterr<-") }, error=function(e) { setGeneric("sterr<-", function(obj, value) standardGeneric("sterr<-")) })
#' @title Set the standard error of `waldCI`
#' @param obj A `waldCI` object
#' @param value The new standard error
#' @return The updated object
setMethod("sterr<-", "waldCI", function(obj, value) {
  obj@sterr <- value
  lb_ub <- .waldCIBounds(obj@level, obj@mean, obj@sterr)
  obj@lb <- lb_ub$lb
  obj@ub <- lb_ub$ub
  validObject(obj)
  return(obj)
})

tryCatch({ setGeneric("level<-") }, error=function(e) { setGeneric("level<-", function(obj, value) standardGeneric("level<-")) })
#' @title Set the confidence level of `waldCI`
#' @param obj A `waldCI` object
#' @param value The new confidence level
#' @return The updated object
setMethod("level<-", "waldCI", function(obj, value) {
  obj@level <- value
  lb_ub <- .waldCIBounds(obj@level, obj@mean, obj@sterr)
  obj@lb <- lb_ub$lb
  obj@ub <- lb_ub$ub
  validObject(obj)
  return(obj)
})
```

A `contains` method

```{r}
setGeneric("contains", function(x, val) standardGeneric("contains"))
#' Check if a numeric value falls within a `waldCI`
#'
#' @param x A `waldCI` object.
#' @param val Numeric value(s) to test.
#' @return Logical vector indicating whether each value lies in `[lb, ub]`.
setMethod("contains", "waldCI", function(x, val) {
  val >= x@lb & val <= x@ub
})
```

An `overlap` method

```{r}
setGeneric("overlap", function(ci1, ci2) standardGeneric("overlap"))
#' Check whether two `waldCI` objects overlap
#'
#' @param ci1 First `waldCI` object.
#' @param ci2 Second `waldCI` object.
#' @return Logical scalar indicating whether `[lb1, ub1]` and `[lb2, ub2]` overlap
setMethod("overlap", signature(ci1 = "waldCI", ci2 = "waldCI"), function(ci1, ci2) {
  return(
    contains(ci1, ci2@lb) || contains(ci1, ci2@ub) ||
    contains(ci2, ci1@lb) || contains(ci2, ci1@ub)
  )
})
```

`as.numeric` to return `c(lb, ub)`.

```{r}
#' Coerce a `waldCI` to a numeric vector `c(lb, ub)`
#'
#' @param x A `waldCI` object.
#' @return Numeric vector of length 2 containing lower and upper bounds.
setGeneric("as.numeric")
setMethod("as.numeric", "waldCI", function(x) {
  c(x@lb, x@ub)
})
```

```{r}
#' Transform a `waldCI` using a function
#'
#' Applies a function to the bounds of a `waldCI` object and returns a new
#' `waldCI` object. Warns that only monotonic transformations make sense.
#'
#' @param x A `waldCI` object
#' @param f A function
#' @return A transformed `waldCI` object.
setGeneric("transformCI", function(x, f) standardGeneric("transformCI"))
setMethod("transformCI", signature(x = "waldCI", f = "ANY"), function(x, f) {
  warning("Only monotonic transformations make sense for transforming a confidence interval.")
  a <- f(x@lb)
  b <- f(x@ub)
  result <- wald_ci(level = x@level, lb = min(a, b), ub = max(a, b))
  return(result)
})
```

Use your waldCI class to create three objects, evaluate the following code

```{r}
ci1 <- wald_ci(level = 0.95, lb = 17.2, ub = 24.7)
ci2 <- wald_ci(level = 0.99, mean = 13, sterr = 2.5)
ci3 <- wald_ci(level = 0.75, lb = 27.43, ub = 39.22)
```

as.numeric(ci3)

lb(ci2)
ub(ci2)

```

mean(ci3) <- 34
level(ci3) <- .8
```

```{r}
contains(ci1, 17)
contains(ci3, 44)
overlap(ci1, ci2)
```

```{r}
eci1 <- transformCI(ci1, sqrt)
eci1
```

```{r}
mean(transformCI(ci2, log))
```

Show that your validator does not allow the creation of invalid confidence intervals

```{r}
# 1. Negative standard error
try(wald_ci(level = 0.95, mean = 10, sterr = -1.5))
```

```{r}
# 2. lb > ub
try(wald_ci(level = 0.95, lb = 25, ub = 10))
```

```{r}
# 3. Infinite bounds
try(wald_ci(level = 0.95, lb = -Inf, ub = 10))
try(wald_ci(level = 0.95, lb = 0, ub = Inf))
```

```{r}
# 4. Invalid use of setters
ci4 <- wald_ci(level = 0.95, mean = 10, sterr = 2)
try(sterr(ci4) <- -0.5)
```

```{r}
ci4 <- wald_ci(level = 0.95, mean = 10, sterr = 2)
try(level(ci4) <- -1)
```

```{r}
ci4 <- wald_ci(level = 0.95, mean = 10, sterr = 2)
try(lb(ci4) <- 15)
```
